signal_scope.embedding_mean_scope: coarse annual surface-change context; included in magnitude comparison but not treated as event-timed proof
signal_scope.dominant_signal_rule: largest of radar_abs_mean, optical_abs_mean, and embedding_mean

criteria.name: output_schema_and_diagnosis_label
criteria.description: Returns the requested six-key JSON object with mechanism_label and diagnosis_label matching the expected quick-clay, wet-context, radar-dominant diagnosis.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a valid but incomplete object or a generic landslide label.

criteria.name: footprint_calculation
criteria.description: Reports 300 m width, 700 m length, 21.0 ha rectangular footprint proxy, and 9 ha debris-flow area.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct source values with a missing or miscomputed rectangle-area conversion.

criteria.name: rainfall_ledger
criteria.description: Uses the 2020-12-26 through 2020-12-30 window and reports 72.2 mm total, 8.9 mm event-day precipitation, 14.44 mm/day wetness index, and 0.1233 event-day fraction.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct window with minor rounding errors; award 1 point for using only the event-day value.

criteria.name: change_signal_comparison
criteria.description: Reports 0.6378 radar, 0.3457 optical, 0.0912 coarse annual embedding context, identifies radar_abs_mean as the dominant mean signal, and computes the 1.845 radar-to-optical ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for identifying radar as largest with one missing value or a minor ratio error; award 1 point for only naming the radar signal.

criteria.name: exposure_context
criteria.description: Reports the rounded population value 1059042 and 1.059 million.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for one of the two population values or a small rounding mistake.

criteria.name: json_implied_formula_consistency
criteria.description: The returned JSON values are internally consistent with the area, wetness, event-day fraction, and radar-to-optical formulas; no prose or formula strings outside the JSON are required.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point when most values are correct but one derived value is not formula-consistent.

criteria.name: overclaim_control
criteria.description: Avoids claiming rainfall proves the trigger or that population exposure is confirmed loss.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for one correct caution with another extra escalation.

provenance.notes: The embedding mean is a coarse annual context value; radar dominance and rainfall/population cautions are scored through the requested JSON fields and judge anchors.
